topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Identify the type of account under which Premium on redemption of debentures account can be classified into?

I. A personal account
II. A real account
III. A Nominal Account
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per AS 21 Consolidated Financial Statements, the excess of costs to the parent of its investment in a subsidiary over the parent's portion of equity of the subsidiary to be taken to __________ in consolidated financial statement.
e: Correct answer: Goodwill (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following statements is associated with the accrual basis of accounting?
o: Revenues are recognized in the period they are earned, regardless of the time period the cash is received
This method is used less frequently by businesses
A minimum amount of record keeping is required
The timing of cash receipts and disbursements is e
Expenses paid for in advance are not accounted for
e: Correct answer: Revenues are recognized in the period they are earned, regardless of the time period the cash is received (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In Facultative Reinsurance the risk taken by the reinsurer is on what basis?
o: Based on the type of portfolio
e: Correct answer: Single insurance policy basis (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which business transaction requires the following journal entry?

Purchases A/c ......Dr Rs. 1,000
      To Cash A/c               Rs. 1,000
o: Cash payment to the supplier of goods
Purchase of an asset for cash
e: Correct answer: Purchase of goods for cash (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 7, which of the following conditions are necessary to establish degree of reliability for fixed price contract?

I. Total contract revenues to be received can be reliably estimated
II. Cost to complete can be reasonable estimated
III. Stage of completion can be measured
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Financial accounting is a full proof process with no limitations. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: Financial Accounting has no limitations and is a c
Financial Accounting has limitations such as it is influenced by personal judgments, it does not show present value of business, it cannot be used for price fixation, etc
e: Correct answer: Financial Accounting has limitations such as it is influenced by personal judgments, it does not show present value of business, it cannot be used for price fixation, etc (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An inventory valuation procedure in which the oldest costs incurred rarely have an effect on the ending inventory valuation is:
e: Correct answer: LIFO (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In classifying the elements of financial statements, the primary distinction between revenues and profits is:-
o: The costs versus the benefits of the alternative m
The nature of the activities that gave rise to the transactions involved
The likelihood that the transactions involved will
The materiality of the amounts involved
The methods of computing revenues and profits
e: Correct answer: The nature of the activities that gave rise to the transactions involved (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The main objective of the the Long-form audit report is to provide information on which of the following aspects of an insurance company?
o: Compliance of accounting policies by the insurance
Process lapses including underwriting, claims, accounts, internal control, investments
Overall true and fair view of the financial statem
Provisions of insurance act relating to applicatio
Management report is in consistency with the Finan
e: Correct answer: Process lapses including underwriting, claims, accounts, internal control, investments (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per the provisions of Companies Act, 2013, when any such shares are redeemed otherwise than out of the proceeds of a fresh issue , there shall, out of profits which would otherwise have been available for dividend, be transferred to the _____________ for the sum equal to the nominal amount of the shares redeemed.
e: Correct answer: Capital Redemption Reserve Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Foreign investment transactions during the year are converted at the exchange rates ___________.
o: Prevailing as on the first day of the month of pur
Prevailing as on the first day of the year of purc
Prevailing as on the last day of the month of purchase or sale
Prevailing as on the last day of the year of purch
That are average of exchange rate during the year
e: Correct answer: Prevailing as on the last day of the month of purchase or sale (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In the system of accounting where the premiums and losses are entered in the accounts according to the treaty criteria for the relevant accounting year without any break up of income (premium) and expenditure (claims/commission) by year of occurrence or underwriting year is known as ______________________
e: Correct answer: Reinsurance Accounting Year System (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is/are correct for money measurement concept?

I. Transactions which can be expressed in monetary terms should only be recorded
II. Records of transaction can be kept under quantitative terms
III. This concept guides accountants as to what to record and what not to record
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
From the following data of a fire insurance company calculate the balance in unexpired reserve at the 31 March 2009.

I. Reserve for unexpired risks as on 1 April 2008 - Rs.7,05,000
II. Net premium received before adjustment for Unexpired Risk reserve - Rs. 18,82,500.
e: Correct answer: Rs.9,41,250 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per IRDAI regulations, every insurers having Asset under Management (AUM) above ______ should appoint a Chartered Accountant Firm for concurrent Audit.
e: Correct answer: Rs.1,000 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Categorise 'non-proportional treaty' with reference to profit commission
o: Such treaties generally have a profit commission c
Such treaties rarely have a profit commission clause
Such treaties ban  profit commission clause
Such treaties support  profit commission clause bu
e: Correct answer: Such treaties rarely have a profit commission clause (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: For short term bonds, debentures, Certificate of deposits, Commercial papers to be treated as Approved investment, what should be the minimum rating prescribed by the IRDAI (Investment) Vth Amendment) Regulations, 2013?
e: Correct answer: P1 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A CAG audit is applicable to which of the below?
o: Foreign General Insurance Companies operating in I
All General Insurance Companies operating in India
e: Correct answer: Public Sector General Insurance Companies (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are included in the list of investments approved by IRDA?

I. Loans secured under the Insurance Act
II. Bonds or debenture issued by companies having minimum credit rating of AA
III. Immoveable property situated in another country
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If a primary insurer wants to reduce its liability in a certain area he should opt for Treaty Reinsurance. What do you say?
o: No, only facultative reinsurance is appropriate in this case
No, only combination treaty is appropriate in this
No, only mixed reinsurance is appropriate in this
No, only obligatory treaty is appropriate in this
e: Correct answer: No, only facultative reinsurance is appropriate in this case (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: For a corporate bond or debenture to be treated as Approved investment, what should be the minimum rating prescribed by the IRDAI (Investment) V<SUP>th</SUP> Amendment) Regulations, 2013?
e: Correct answer: AA (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Insurers who reinsures the reinsurer's risks are  known as _____________.
e: Correct answer: Retrocessionaires (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Dalhousie Ltd of issued 100,000 equity shares. These were underwritten by underwriters being A, B & C as A for 40%, for 35% and C for 25%. In all, applications for 80,000 shares were received; applications for 20,000 shares bear the stamp of A; those for 10,000 shares that of B, and those for 20,000 shares that of C. There were also applications for 30,000 shares which did not bear any stamp. It is decided that credit for unmarked applications is given to A, B, and C in proportion to their gross liability. Determine the liability of A.
e: Correct answer: 6670 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The Annual report prepared is submitted to the ___________.
e: Correct answer: Shareholders (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A reinsurer is seeking a reinsurance contract where it is ready for obligatory acceptance of the reinsurance ceded. Predict, with reasonable accuracy which type it will finally select.
e: Correct answer: Treaty reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which one of the following statements is correct about contingent assets?

I. Contingent assets should not be recognised
II. Contingent assets are recognised if there is certainty of recovery
III. Contingent assets are recognised if they relate to the entity
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: XYZ general insurance is framing its investment policy. What is the minimum percentage of the total investments, a general insurance company is required to make in government securities?
e: Correct answer: 20% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements relating to advances is incorrect?

I. The internal auditor examines all advances paid to employees in respect of travelling, LTS and other advances
II. All advances need to be deducted from salaries
III. Advance register should be examined thoroughly (by the internal auditor) for each advance and settlement thereof
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Debt securities including government securities and redeemable preference shares for a general insurance company shall be considered to be ________.
e: Correct answer: Held to maturity (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
With regards to the valuation of an equity instruments and derivative instrument traded in active market of a general insurance company, which of the following statements is/are true?

I. These shall be measured at fair value
II. The company should assess at each balance sheet date for any impairment
III. Unrealised gains/losses arising due to changes in the fair value shall be taken to equity under the head 'Fair Value Change Account'
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The IRDAI regulations require insurance companies to adhere to the following accounting policies:

I. All accounting standards issued by the ICAI except AS 3, AS 13 & AS 17
II. all accounting policies mentioned under AS-1 issued by the ICAI
III. Accounting standard prescribed by IASB
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per IRDAI regulations, every insurer having Assets under Management (AUM) not more than _______ shall have a Quality Internal Audit.
e: Correct answer: Rs.1,000 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with the IRDAI circular prescribing maximum agency and brokerage commission, the maximum brokerage permissible for Fire insurance business is:-
e: Correct answer: 12.5% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is not related to money measurement concept?

I. All business transactions should be expressed in terms of money
II. The transactions which cannot be expressed in money, will not be recorded in accounting books
III. Business is treated as separate from its owners
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: How much is the maximum percentage of the total investments, allowed by a general insurance company in approved investments and other investments specified under section 27B(3) of the IRDAI Act?
e: Correct answer: 55% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A bank reconciliation statement has been prepared by an inexperienced book keeper on 31st December 2012. He started with an overdraft balance of 10,000 as per bank statement and subtracted cheques deposited but not cleared and added the unpresented cheques worth 28,240 and 8,360 respectively and arrived at overdrawn cash book balance of 9,880

What should be the cash book balance as per your assessment?<
e: Correct answer: Rs. 9,880 overdraft (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per the golden rules of accounting, from the statements given below, which one is applicable to real accounts?
o: Debit all expenses and losses and credit all incom
Credit  the receiver and  debit the giver
Debit the receiver and credit the giver
Credit all expenses and losses and  debit all inco
Debit what comes in and credit what goes out
e: Correct answer: Debit what comes in and credit what goes out (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is not an objective of the accounting policies?
e: Correct answer: Going concern (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The areas wherein different accounting policies can be adopted include:

I. Providing depreciation
II. Creation of reserve for unexpired risk
III. Valuation of investment
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An impairment loss in the value of Equity Securities and Derivative Instruments that are traded in active markets shall be recognised as an _________ in ________ to the extent of the difference between the remeasured fair value of the security/ investment and its acquisition cost as reduced by any previous impairment loss recognised.
e: Correct answer: Expense; Revenue Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is not true regarding the provisions of preference shares in the Companies Act, 2013?

I. A company if authorized by its Articles of Association, may issue redeemable preference shares
II. A company can also issue irredeemable preference shares
III. The premium, if payable on redemption, must be provided for out of the profits of the company
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following costs are not included in the original (total) cost of a fixed asset?
o: Stamp duty or import duty paid for acquiring the a
Cost of the maintenance team that looks after the asset
e: Correct answer: Cost of the maintenance team that looks after the asset (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is not a salient feature of Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS)?

I. Helps to detect many discrepancies and irregularities in financial transactions
II. Any undue delay in clearance of cheque will be reflected in BRS
III. Reconciliation is done by the bankers
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Every insurer shall draw up, ___________, an investment policy and place the policy before the board of directors for approval.

I. Quarterly
II. Half yearly
III. Annually
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
An enterprise generally makes changes in accounting policies in which of the following circumstances?

I. To bring the books of accounts in accordance with the Accounting Standards
II. To comply with the provisions of law
III. To ensure that the changed circumstances or methods will reflect a truer and fairer view of the financial statements
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are out of the scope of AS 9 Revenue Recognition?

I. Revenue arising from construction contracts
II. Revenue arising from hire purchase or lease agreements
III. Revenue arising from Govt. grant and other similar subsidies
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A sales invoice of Rs.1,542 was recorded in the books of Aman Ltd as follows: Dr Sales Rs.1,254 Cr Receivables Rs.1,254 (Being sale of goods) The error was not corrected before the trial balance was extracted. How will Peter's profit for the year be affected?
e: Correct answer: Understated by Rs.2,796 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is incorrect?

I. Provisions should be reflected in the financial statements when an enterprise has no present obligation as a result of a past event
II. Contingent assets should be reflected in the financial statements
III. Contingent liabilities should not be provided in the financial statements, even there is possibility of outflow of resources
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).
